text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! 'Cause I gave it everything 
I had!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...I gave it everything I had, but I 
couldn't take first place."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now I can never become a "Triple Crown 
Umamusume" anymore...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it is no longer possible to equal 
the title of "Triple Crown Umamusume" that 
Symboli Rudolf earned—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! My challenge doesn't 
end here!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I gotta train like crazy so I can 
definitely win next time!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio possesses not just exceptional 
ability, but remarkable mental fortitude 
as well...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At her request, we were to resume training 
the very day after the race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's start training! Let's do 
our best for the remaining two crowns! 
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, I'd like to do some 
tandem training again.
choice_data_list:
Are you okay? Still fatigued from the 
race?

Are you okay? Still feeling the fatigue 
from the race?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Having run the Satsuki Sho, I realize now 
just how hard it is to win a Classic race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And do you even know what her next race 
is, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The Derby that every Umamusume 
dreams of!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Everyone will be desperate and coming to 
win. So I have to put everything on the 
line too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So with that, I'm off to do some tandem 
training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio practically forced the issue 
and went off for her tandem training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, without a moment's rest, training 
for the Japanese Derby began.
